_comment: DECISION NEEDED (Nisarg): the list of restricted jurisdictions. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, matched against the country the edge network reports for the request (Vercel: x-vercel-ip-country; Cloudflare: cf-ipcountry). India is blocked by default per the brief. The OFAC comprehensively sanctioned countries are included as a conservative default. The United States is NOT in the default list: prediction markets are restricted there (CFTC) and blocking it is a legal decision, flagged for counsel; set it in `restricted` to enforce it.

restrictedSubdivisions._comment: ISO 3166-2 subdivisions, e.g. Crimea UA-43, Donetsk UA-14, Luhansk UA-09 (OFAC). Matched against x-vercel-ip-country-region (the part after the dash).

decisionsNeeded: Confirm or change the list above with counsel (US, UK, Singapore, France, Australia and others restrict prediction markets or derivatives).

Decide whether judges and reviewers get a bypass link while the product is in a legal grey zone. Implemented but OFF: set REGION_BYPASS_TOKEN (16+ characters) in the hosting env, then open /?region_bypass=<token> once on a device. Without the variable there is no bypass.
